jobs.title: Senior People Program Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT TEKION:

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.


JOB INTRODUCTION

 Tekion is entering its next phase of growth and is looking for a People Program Manager to support day-to-day People Program operations and help scale the infrastructure that powers our employee experience in India. 

 This is an individual contributor role focused on strong execution, program ownership, and operational excellence. You will partner closely with People Operations, People Partners, Talent Acquisition, Legal/Privacy, and Systems teams to deliver consistent, compliant, and employee centric People programs. For globally owned People programs, this role will serve as the India execution lead, responsible for localizing requirements, coordinating stakeholders, and ensuring successful delivery and adoption in India. 




KEY ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own and execute People programs end-to-end including performance management cycles, engagement surveys, internal talent movement programs, People/HR system upgrades, and compliance related initiatives. 

 - Manage project delivery by building and maintaining project plans, timelines, milestones, dependencies, and status updates; proactively identify risks and drive mitigation. 

 - Operationalize programs by supporting governance, operating rhythms, documentation, and handoffs to ensure programs are sustainable beyond initial launch. 

 - Drive standardization and continuous improvement by maintaining core program artifacts (project charter, RACI, project plan, comms plan, launch readiness checklist, building repeatable playbooks/SOPs, and running post-launch retros to capture learnings and improve future cycles. 

 - Create clear, scalable resources such as process guides, FAQs, templates, and manager communications to enable self-service and consistent execution. 

 - Partner with Legal/Privacy and India compliance experts to ensure programs align with local statutory, audit, and data privacy requirements. 

 - Maintain and analyze People data, including reporting, data audits, and basic dashboards to track program health and identify improvement opportunities. 

 - Support the People team’s operating cadence, including preparation for Monthly and Quarterly Business Reviews and readiness for peak People cycles. 

What success looks like in this role 

 - Core People programs and cycles run smoothly, on time, and with minimal escalations. 

 - Stakeholders have clear visibility into timelines, ownership, and expectations for People & Cross-functional programs. 

 - Processes and documentation are clear enough to enable consistent execution and increased self-service 

 - The People team can rely on this role for strong operational follow-through and program readiness. 

 About you 

 - A strong executor who brings structure to ambiguity and reliably follows through on commitments. 

 - A process-oriented thinker who looks for practical improvements on that scale. 

 - A collaborative partner who communicates clearly with cross functional stakeholders and balances people's needs with business priorities. 

 - Detail oriented and organized with the confidence to raise risks and push back when needed. 
   
   


BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 

 - 4–6 years of experience in HR/People Programs, HR/People Operations, HR/People Project Management, or related roles, ideally in a fast growing or mid to large organization. 

 - Hands-on experience delivering cross-functional projects or recurring cycles (e.g., performance reviews, engagement surveys, system rollouts). 

 - Working knowledge of project management tools (e.g., Jira, Microsoft Planner, Asana) and strong documentation practices. 

 - Solid Excel or Google Sheets skills for reporting, tracking, and basic analysis of HR data. 

 - Experience working with vendors or internal service providers to track deliverables and timelines. 

 - Comfort collaborating with global stakeholders across time zones, including India–US teams. 
   
   


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Exposure to India compliance topics (e.g., statutory processes, audits) through partnership with subject matter experts 

 - Experience with People systems such as Workday (or equivalent HRIS), Greenhouse or Ashby (ATS), or similar tools. 

 - Formal project management training or certification (PMP, Prince2, or equivalent). 
   
   


PERKS & BENEFITS 

 - Opportunity to work with some of the smartest minds to solve complex challenges at scale. 

 - Impactful role in shaping and securing a global, cloud-native & AI driven platform. 

 - Innovative, collaborative, and fast-paced culture.

jobs.description:
ABOUT TEKION:

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

We are seeking a Finance Operations Lead to oversee our SaaS billing, Accounts Receivable (AR), and subscription revenue recognition. You will lead financial operations and play a critical role in optimizing our ERP infrastructure. The ideal candidate brings strong experience in ERP implementations and complex SaaS billing models, with NetSuite experience being a major advantage.
Key Responsibilities
SaaS Revenue & Billing Operations

 - Manage the end-to-end SaaS billing cycle, including new subscriptions, renewals, upsells, and mid-term upgrades.

 - Oversee deferred revenue and SaaS revenue recognition compliance under ASC 606 / IFRS 15 frameworks.

 - Manage automated subscription billing schedules, usage-based metrics, and multi-tier pricing structures.

 - Monitor AR aging reports, manage churn risk, and drive dunning and collections workflows.

 - Reconcile SaaS metrics (MRR, ARR, LTV) with core accounting ledgers during month-end close.

ERP Implementation & System Integration

 - Lead or support the implementation, testing, and deployment of SaaS-specific ERP modules.

 - Migrate legacy customer subscriptions and historical financial data into the new system.

 - Integrate NetSuite/ERP with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) and specialized subscription billing engines.

 - Map quote-to-cash workflows to maximize automated invoicing and minimize manual calculations.

 - Establish system documentation and train the finance team on new ERP processes.

Team Leadership & Process Optimization

 - Supervise, mentor, and scale a lean team of billing and revenue specialists.

 - Identify bottlenecks in the cash-collection cycle and automate recurring payment workflows.

 - Provide data-driven insights on billing anomalies, credit memos, and bad debt reserves.

Qualifications and Skills
Education & Experience

 - Experience: 8+ years of experience in finance operations, specifically within the SaaS or subscription tech industry.

 - Qualification: Graduation completion, Chartered Accountant (CA) or Semi-Qualified CA preferred.

 - ERP Expertise: Mandatory hands-on experience driving or supporting an ERP implementation.

 - System Knowledge: Strong proficiency in NetSuite (especially Advanced Revenue Management / SuiteBilling) is a distinct advantage.

Core Competencies

 - Deep knowledge of SaaS billing metrics, revenue deferrals, and contract modifications.

 - Advanced Excel skills for manipulating large data sets during system migrations.

 - Strong project management abilities to meet strict implementation timelines.

jobs.title: Senior People Business Partner
jobs.description:
ABOUT TEKION:

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.


JOB INTRODUCTION

The Senior People Business Partner is one of the most important roles on our People team.

You are the bridge between our business and our People strategy — and you are far more than a resource the business calls when something goes wrong. You are a proactive, strategic thought partner who helps business leaders build teams people are proud to be part of. This role requires someone who is equally invested in the success of their client groups and the success of the People team itself. You will carry a portfolio of business units and be expected to know them deeply — their goals, their challenges, their people, and what it will take to make them perform at their best. You will operate in an environment that is still being built. Systems will be imperfect. Processes will evolve. Ambiguity will be a daily companion. We need someone who sees this not as a liability but as the opportunity it is—to build something great, in real time, that will outlast you. 

This is a full-time in office role in our beautiful Pleasanton, CA office.




KEY ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES 

 - Strategic Partnership: Build deep, trusted, long-term relationships with business unit leaders and their teams. Serve as a genuine thought partner — not just a service provider —on organizational health, talent strategy, and team effectiveness.

 - Business Acumen: Develop a thorough understanding of each client group's business model, goals, and pressures. Use that knowledge to anticipate needs, shape people strategies proactively, and connect People initiatives directly to business outcomes.

 - Organizational & Talent Development: Partner with leaders to build high-performing, engaged teams. Drive org design, succession planning, performance management, and leadership development with rigor and intentionality.

 - Employee Relations: Navigate complex employee situations with sound judgment, empathy, and legal awareness. Provide thoughtful guidance that protects the business and the individual simultaneously.

 - Change Leadership: Champion people-related transformation initiatives. Communicate change with clarity and conviction, build alignment across stakeholders, and help leaders bring their teams through transitions effectively.

 - People Team Investment: Actively contribute to the strength, culture, and continuous improvement of the People team itself. Share knowledge, collaborate across COEs, and show up as a champion for the function — not just your portfolio.

 - Program Execution: Drive the end-to-end execution of People programs across your client groups —performance cycles, engagement actions, compensation planning, and more —with precision and follow-through.

 - Builder Mindset: Identify gaps, design solutions, and build People infrastructure where it doesn't yet exist. Leave every client group — and the People team itself — better than you found it.

 - Consultative Expertise: Apply advanced analytical skills and deep People knowledge to diagnose business needs, recommend strategic solutions, and navigate complex people-related challenges. You don't just respond to what leaders ask —you help them see what they haven't asked yet.

 - Continuous Learning: Stay current on emerging HR trends, tools, and best practices. Actively seek new ways to improve how we operate and add value —to your client groups, to the People team, and to the organization as a whole.




BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

 - Education: BS/BA degree or equivalent professional experience.

 - Experience: 8–10 years of HRBP or People Business Partner experience, preferably in a fast-growth SaaS or technology company.

 - Strategic Influence: Demonstrated ability to build trusted advisory relationships with senior and C-suite leaders — not just execute requests but shape thinking.

 - Business Fluency: Ability to learn a business quickly, connect People initiatives to business outcomes, and speak the language of the leaders you support.

 - ER Expertise: Sound judgment and experience handling complex employee relations situations with care, consistency, and appropriate urgency.

 - Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication — clear, direct, and compelling across audiences from ICs to executives.

 - Organizational Agility: Comfortable managing a broad portfolio of priorities in a fast-moving environment without losing precision or follow-through.

 - Resilience: Able to absorb feedback, adapt quickly, and maintain composure and positivity when things don't go as planned — because sometimes they won't.

 - Drive to Make Others Successful: You measure your own success by how much better the people and teams around you are performing. Seeing others grow, succeed, and thrive because of your partnership is what fuels you.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience in a high-growth startup or company scaling through significant organizational change.

 - Track record of building or rebuilding People programs from scratch.

 - Experience supporting global or international business units.

 - Workday proficiency (HCM, Recruiting, Talent).

 - Exposure to M&A, rapid headcount scaling, or organizational redesign.

 - Demonstrated ability to gain energy from — not be depleted by — highly complex organizational problems.

 - High consultative experience influencing senior leaders through insight and data, not authority.




WORK STYLE REQUIREMENTS

We are intentional about these requirements because our environment demands them. Please read carefully before applying.

 - This role is based in our Pleasanton, CA office and requires 5 days per week in office

 - We are a collaborative, high-energy team that does its best work together. In-office presence is not optional and is not negotiable.

 - Please apply only if you are currently located in or are prepared to relocate to the East Bay area of the San Francisco Bay Area, and can commit to this schedule without exception.

 - Tekion operates globally. Our teams span North America, India, and other international locations.

 - You should expect occasional early mornings or late evenings to support global partners and leaders.

 - Flexibility and a 'no-drama' approach to shifting schedules is part of how this role operates.

 - This is a demanding, high-ownership role in a company that is growing fast and building constantly.

 - We do not expect perfection. We do expect full engagement, strong judgment, and a bias toward action.

 - If you are energized by a lot to do, the ability to make a real impact, and an environment where great work is noticed — this is the right place.


PERKS & BENEFITS

 - Competitive compensation and generous stock options

 - 100% employer-paid top-of-the-line medical, dental, and vision coverage

 - Unlimited PTO, parental leave, and free snacks and beverages

 - The opportunity to work with some of the brightest minds from Silicon Valley's most successful companies

 - Early-stage, hyper-growth startup with significant career growth opportunity

 - Home-grown, ground-up technology — everything we build, we own

 - A dynamic, collaborative work environment with a strong sense of community

 - Open, transparent culture that rewards performance and encourages innovation

You have a growth mindset — and you mean it.

JOB INTRODUCTION:

 

The Customer Value Manager is the primary owner of the customer relationship and long-term success of assigned dealership accounts within Tekion’s Customer Value Services organization. This is not a support role with a retention overlay. It is a strategic value leadership role responsible for understanding each dealer’s business goals, connecting those goals to measurable outcomes within the Tekion platform, and ensuring value is visible, documented, and expanding over time.

The Customer Value Manager serves as the strategic quarterback for every account in the portfolio. This role leads the ongoing customer relationship across operational and executive stakeholders, owns the Customer Value Plan (CVP) for each account, drives outcome-focused Value Reviews, maintains visibility into portfolio health and risk, and helps ensure renewals and expansion opportunities are supported by a clear, data-backed value narrative. The Customer Value Manager partners closely with Customer Value Architects, who provide product expertise and maturity diagnostics, and with Virtual Value Managers, who help support account activity between strategic touchpoints. Together, these roles help close the gap between what a dealer purchased and the value they are actually realizing.

 


KEY ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Own the customer relationship across assigned dealership accounts, building and maintaining trusted relationships with operational contacts, general managers, dealer principals, and other key stakeholders

 - Develop, maintain, and execute a Customer Value Plan for every account in the portfolio, ensuring plans remain current, actionable, and aligned to dealer priorities and business outcomes

 - Lead regular Value Reviews that replace traditional QBRs with structured, outcome-focused conversations grounded in dealer performance, platform adoption, operational progress, and realized value

 - Partner with Customer Value Architects (CVAs) to interpret Dealer Maturity Model (DMM) positioning, product adoption data, workflow maturity, and module utilization in order to shape account strategy and identify value gaps

 - Translate platform usage, operational performance, and maturity progress into a compelling value narrative that helps customers understand where they are realizing value and where additional opportunity exists

 - Maintain visibility into portfolio health through active management of account health indicators, maturity assessments, customer risks, renewal status, and expansion potential

 - Forecast renewal readiness across the portfolio, ensuring each renewal is anticipated, supported by documented evidence of realized value, and aligned with Sales-led execution

 - Identify and surface expansion opportunities in partnership with Sales by understanding customer needs, value realization progress, operational gaps, and growth potential across accounts

 - Represent the voice of the customer internally by escalating risks, highlighting friction points, advocating for improvements, and informing internal priorities that improve customer outcomes

 - Partner with Virtual Value Managers (VVMs) to ensure account documentation, operational support activity, weekly account digests, and proactive dealer touchpoints help reinforce broader customer strategy

 - Ensure Customer Value Plan documentation, account records, and customer interaction history remain current, accurate, and useful for internal alignment and execution

 - Monitor customer progress against agreed goals and maturity milestones, helping dealers move forward in a structured way across the Tekion Dealer Maturity Model

 - Coordinate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Support, Enablement, Implementations, and other internal teams as needed to remove blockers, align account strategy, and improve customer outcomes

 - Operate effectively in a high-growth environment where portfolio size, segment design, account structures, and team configurations may evolve over time

 - Travel to dealership sites and customer engagement events as needed to strengthen relationships, support value conversations, and improve understanding of dealer operations

 - Support broader Customer Value Services goals by improving retention readiness, expansion visibility, customer trust, and measurable value realization across the portfolio

 


BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Automotive Management, Communications, or related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience accepted in lieu of degree

 - 3–5 years of experience in customer value, account management, client-facing consulting, or a related customer-facing role in a SaaS environment

 - Demonstrated ability to manage executive relationships and lead value-focused conversations with dealer principals, general managers, or comparable senior customer stakeholders

 - Strong analytical instincts, including the ability to review performance data, adoption trends, and operational signals and translate them into a compelling customer value narrative

 - Experience developing account plans, success plans, value plans, or comparable structured customer engagement strategies preferred

 - Experience forecasting account health, renewal risk, or expansion opportunity across a portfolio preferred

 - Experience collaborating cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Support, Enablement, or similar internal teams to improve customer outcomes

 - Familiarity with CRM platforms such as Salesforce preferred

 - Familiarity with business intelligence and reporting tools such as Tableau, Looker, or Power BI preferred

 - Automotive industry experience or familiarity with dealership operations strongly preferred

 - Ability and willingness to travel up to 50% for dealership visits, onsite engagement, and customer events

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to lead executive conversations and prepare clear internal account context

 - Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with shifting priorities, portfolio needs, and organizational structures

 


PERKS & BENEFITS
